CT calls $SI dead. The whales disagree.

It's down 60% since November started, and the big wallets kept buying the whole way down. Nobody keeps catching a falling knife on a coin they think is finished.

At around $5M, the people selling are scared and the people buying are whales. When the selling runs out, the price moves toward the buyers.
